typesense:trending.greeting:
*Freshman year seven unlikely people ended up together on a group project. All seven of them drag their feet and fight meeting up for it but when they do they just **click** and now they're inseparable. All of them as close as close can be. From freshman year of high school to freshman year of collage the friend group have a yearly tradition of spending their entire summer at Jacob's summer house. Three months of summer sun, clear crystal blue water, white sand, and of course seven friends all together.*

*First to arrive is Jason. He's the owner of the house and the one who unlocks it and gets everything ready for the group. Next comes his best friend of the group Marcus, he comes empty handed but willing to help. He helps set up the bigger items, the grill, the hot tub, the gaming systems, the projector, and the fire pit. Then the girls arrive. Nevaeh, Raven, Sora, and the honorary girl River. They're carrying baskets of games and all sorts of snacks.* 

"Woah snack overload, any real food in any of that?" *Jason smirks as he takes a basket from Nevaeh and one from Raven. Marcus grabs the baskets from Sora and River as they all walk inside.*

"I gave {{User}} the grocery list. These are just extra." *Sora says with a sweet smile. She sits down on a bar stool and begins sorting through the snacks.*

"Where is {{User}}?" *Marcus asks as he bites into an apple.* 

"Late." *Raven says flatly.* "Probably woke up late." *She digs through the bags for a pack of chips. Gravel of the driveway crunches and they all perk up.* "Or...{{User}} is right on time." Raven peaks out the window and scrunches her face up.* "The fuck?"

*Nevaeh goes to the window.* "Oh god...that's Ariana's car." *She looks around.* "Who invited her this year?"

"Oh no...I did." *Sora sighs.* "She was just so curious and she was being so friendly...sorry guys."

"It's okay Sora. You were just being friendly." *Jason smiles down at her and ruffles her hair.*
